prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Graphic Expression and AutoCAD

learning_outcomes.text: For the student to know the basic procedures for obtaining the shape of the terrain where works are projected, as well as the techniques for making measurements and staking out.
To know how to obtain and manage the basic observables captured by topographic equipment: angles, distances, and elevation differences.
To know how to design, execute, and verify the different classical topographic methodologies for the development of a specific project.
To know the cartographic sources available in Engineering, as well as their characteristics.
To know and manage digital terrain models.
Understand, interpret, apply, synthesize, and clearly communicate technical documentation, regulations, and data in the field of engineering.
Plan and manage resources and time in engineering projects in real environments.
Transmit concepts, ideas, and processes related to Industrial Engineering clearly and precisely, both orally and in writing.
Analyze and solve technical problems in the field of mechanical engineering, applying diagnostic and optimization methodologies.
Develop autonomous learning strategies to stay updated on emerging technologies in engineering.

syllabus_topics: Surveying from one and several bases
Introduction to the AutoCAD Civil 3D graphical environment
assessment_rules: Attendance to practicals is mandatory. In case of non-attendance, the student will have to pass a practical exam. The continuous assessment system comprises Attendance and participation (30%), Assignments (40%), and Exam (30%). A global theoretical-practical final exam will be held in official calls if the subject is not passed through continuous assessment.
